newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares track Bunds down after U.S. GDP data.
newsitem.headline: German shares track Bunds down after U.S. GDP data.

text.p: 1238 GMT - German shares fall into negative territory in post-bourse electronic dealings, tracking a decline in Bunds after U.S. Q1 GDP data shows string economic growth.
* IBIS DAX index down 5.31 points at 3,420.55, off low of 3,416.11 points. DAX ended bourse session at 3,434.07 points.
* Bayer remains lower after Q1 data.
* Schering still buoyed by share buyback, Q1 earnings news.
* U.S. GDP up 5.6 percent versus forecasts for 4.1 percent rise.
